把英文搭配和中文含义整体记忆；填入句子时注意时态和主谓一致。

example: My teacher asked me to read aloud.
question: My teacher asked me ___ read aloud.
note: ask 后先放人，再接 to do；否定式 ask sb not to do sth。

example: She told me to wait here.
question: She told me ___ wait here.
note: tell sb not to do sth 表示告诉某人不要做某事。

example: I want you to stay.
question: I want you ___ stay.
note: want 后可以接 to do，也可以接 sb to do。

en: would like sb to do sth
example: I would like you to join us.
question: I would like you ___ join us.
note: would like 比 want 更委婉。

example: We expect him to arrive soon.
question: We expect him ___ arrive soon.
note: expect to do 期待自己做；expect sb to do 期待别人做。

example: They allow us to use the room.
translation: 他们允许我们使用这个房间。
question: They allow us ___ use the room.
note: allow sb to do；没有具体的人时可用 allow doing。

example: The teacher advised me to practice daily.
question: The teacher advised me ___ practice daily.
note: advise sb to do；advise doing。不要写 advise sb doing。

example: My friend encouraged me to try again.
question: My friend encouraged me ___ try again.
note: encourage 后的人是 to do 动作的执行者。

example: They invited us to have dinner.
question: They invited us ___ have dinner.
note: invite sb to + 地点／活动；invite sb to do + 动作。

example: Please remind me to call her.
question: Please remind me ___ call her.
note: remind sb to do 提醒去做；remind sb of sth 使想起。

example: She persuaded me to take the course.
question: She persuaded me ___ take the course.
note: 可换为 persuade sb into doing sth。

example: Nobody can force you to agree.
question: Nobody can force you ___ agree.
note: 被动式 be forced to do sth。

en: warn sb not to do sth
example: He warned me not to touch it.
question: He warned me not ___ touch it.
note: not 放在 to 前；也可用 warn sb against doing。

example: My father taught me to swim.
question: My father taught me ___ swim.
note: teach 的过去式是 taught。

example: Practice enables us to improve.
question: Practice enables us ___ improve.
note: enable 强调使某人具备能力或条件。

example: She helped me finish the work.
question: She helped me ___ the work. (finish)
note: help 后 to 可有可无；help sb with sth 也表示帮助。

example: The story made me laugh.
question: The story made me ___. (laugh)
note: 主动式不用 to；被动式 be made to do 要补回 to。

example: Let me help you.
question: Let me ___ you. (help)
note: let sb do，后接动词原形。

example: I had him check the answer.
question: I had him ___ the answer. (check)
note: have sb do 强调安排某人做。区分 have sth done。

example: I got him to check the answer.
question: I got him ___ check the answer.
note: have sb do；get sb to do，get 不能漏 to。

zh: 看见某人做某事的全过程
example: I saw him cross the road.
question: I saw him ___ the road from one side to the other. (cross)
note: do 强调整个过程；doing 强调当时正在发生。

example: I saw him crossing the road when I looked out.
translation: 我往外看时看见他正在过马路。
question: I saw him ___ the road when I looked out. (cross)
note: doing 表示看见时正在进行的动作。

example: I could hear her singing in the next room.
translation: 我能听见她正在隔壁唱歌。
question: I could hear her ___ in the next room. (sing)
note: hear sb do 侧重完整事件；hear sb doing 侧重正在进行。

zh: 让某事被做；请人做某事
example: I had my bike repaired.
question: I had my bike ___. (repair)
note: sth 与 done 是被动关系；也可表示遭遇某事。

example: Sorry to keep you waiting.
question: Sorry to keep you ___. (wait)
note: keep sb doing 表示让某人持续做。

en: find it + adj. + to do sth
example: I find it useful to review daily.
translation: 我发现每天复习很有用。
question: I find ___ useful to review daily.
note: it 是形式宾语，真正内容是后面的 to do。

en: It takes sb time to do sth
example: It takes me an hour to get home.
question: It takes me an hour ___ get home.
note: It 作形式主语；人用宾格 me/him/her。

en: It is + adj. + for sb to do sth
zh: 对某人来说，做某事是……的
example: It is important for us to review.
question: It is important ___ us to review.
note: for 引出动作执行者；important/difficult/easy 描述事情。

en: It is + adj. + of sb to do sth
zh: 某人做某事，体现其……品质
example: It is kind of you to help me.
question: It is kind ___ you to help me.
note: kind/nice/careless 等评价人的品质时常用 of。

example: He is too tired to work.
question: He is too tired ___ work.
note: 通常含否定意义，不要再机械添加 not。

example: She is old enough to travel alone.
translation: 她年龄够大，可以独自旅行。
question: She is old enough ___ travel alone.
note: 形容词放 enough 前；enough money 中 enough 放名词前。

example: I was so tired that I fell asleep.
question: I was ___ tired that I fell asleep.
note: so + 形容词；such 常修饰含名词的短语。

example: It was such a good book that I read it twice.
translation: 这本书太好了，我读了两遍。
question: It was ___ a good book that I read it twice.
note: 单数可数名词前需 a/an；such a good book。

example: I spend an hour reading every day.
question: I spend an hour ___ every day. (read)
note: 人作主语；in 可以省略；spend money on sth。

example: I have difficulty remembering names.
question: I have difficulty ___ names. (remember)
note: difficulty 在这里不可数；in 可以省略。

example: She has trouble sleeping.
question: She has trouble ___. (sleep)
note: 不要写 have trouble to do。

example: He is busy preparing for the exam.
question: He is busy ___ for the exam. (prepare)
note: be busy with sth；be busy doing sth。

example: I enjoy reading.
question: I enjoy ___. (read)
note: enjoy 后接动名词，不接 to do。

example: Try to avoid making the same mistake.
translation: 尽量避免犯同样的错误。
question: Try to avoid ___ the same mistake. (make)
note: avoid 后接 doing。

example: I finished writing the report.
question: I finished ___ the report. (write)
note: finish 后接 doing。

example: Would you mind opening the window?
question: Would you mind ___ the window? (open)
note: 回答“不介意”可用 Not at all。

example: Practice speaking English every day.
question: Practice ___ English every day. (speak)
note: 美式动词 practice；英式动词 practise。

example: We are considering moving.
question: We are considering ___. (move)
note: consider doing 考虑做；consider sb to be 认为某人是。

example: She suggested taking a break.
question: She suggested ___ a break. (take)
note: 不用 suggest sb to do；可用 suggest that sb (should) do。

example: He admitted making a mistake.
question: He admitted ___ a mistake. (make)
note: admit doing 或 admit having done。

example: Don't risk losing your work.
translation: 不要冒丢失成果的风险。
question: Don't risk ___ your work. (lose)
note: risk 后接 doing。

example: I feel like going for a walk.
question: I feel like ___ for a walk. (go)
note: like 在这里是介词，后接 doing。

example: I look forward to seeing you.
question: I look forward to ___ you. (see)
note: 这里的 to 是介词，后接名词或 doing。

example: I am used to getting up early.
question: I am used to ___ up early. (get)
note: 此处 to 是介词；used to do 表示过去常常。

example: This tool is used to cut paper.
question: This tool is used ___ cut paper.
note: 这是 use 的被动语态；be used for doing 表达类似意思。

example: I used to live here.
question: I used ___ live here.
note: 表示过去的习惯或状态，通常暗示现在不同。

example: Pay attention to spelling words correctly.
question: Pay attention to ___ words correctly. (spell)
note: to 是介词，不是所有 to 后都接动词原形。

example: She is devoted to helping others.
question: She is devoted to ___ others. (help)
note: devote oneself to doing；to 为介词。

example: They object to working late.
question: They object to ___ late. (work)
note: to 为介词，后接 doing。

en: prefer doing A to doing B
zh: 比起做 B 更喜欢做 A
example: I prefer walking to driving.
translation: 比起开车，我更喜欢步行。
question: I prefer walking ___ driving.
note: 两边形式保持一致；to 是介词。

en: prefer to do A rather than do B
zh: 宁愿做 A 而不愿做 B
example: I prefer to walk rather than drive.
translation: 我宁愿步行，也不愿开车。
question: I prefer to walk rather than ___. (drive)
note: rather than 后与前面的不定式并列，通常省略 to。

example: Remember to lock the door before you leave.
question: Remember ___ the door before you leave. (lock)
note: to do：事情还没做，提醒去做。

example: I remember locking the door last night.
question: I remember ___ the door last night. (lock)
note: doing：回忆已经做过的事。

example: I forgot to bring my keys, so I couldn't get in.
translation: 我忘了带钥匙，所以进不去。
question: I forgot ___ my keys, so I couldn't get in. (bring)
note: to do：该做却没做；forget doing：忘了曾做过。

example: Please stop talking and listen.
question: Please stop ___ and listen. (talk)
note: 停止的是 doing 这个动作。

zh: 停下原来的事，去做另一件事
example: We stopped to rest after walking for two hours.
translation: 走了两小时后，我们停下来休息。
question: We stopped ___ after walking for two hours. (rest)
note: to do 表示停下来的目的。

example: I tried to open the door, but it was locked.
question: I tried ___ the door, but it was locked. (open)
note: try to do 强调努力尝试完成。

example: If the computer is slow, try restarting it.
question: If the computer is slow, try ___ it. (restart)
note: try doing 强调试一种方法，看是否有效。

example: We regret to inform you that the trip is cancelled.
translation: 我们遗憾地通知你，旅行取消了。
question: We regret ___ you that the trip is cancelled. (inform)
note: 常见于 regret to say/tell/inform。

example: I regret wasting so much time.
translation: 我后悔浪费了那么多时间。
question: I regret ___ so much time. (waste)
note: doing 是已发生、让人后悔的事。

example: I meant to call you, but I forgot.
translation: 我本打算给你打电话，但忘了。
question: I meant ___ you, but I forgot. (call)
note: mean to do 表示有意、打算。

example: This job means working at night.
translation: 这份工作意味着要上夜班。
question: This job means ___ at night. (work)
note: mean doing 表示意味着。

example: The room needs cleaning.
question: The room needs ___. (clean)
note: need doing 主动形式表被动，可换 need to be done。

example: The book is worth reading.
question: The book is worth ___. (read)
note: worth 后用 doing，主动形式表示被动含义。

en: There is no point in doing sth
example: There is no point in arguing.
question: There is no point in ___. (argue)
note: in 是介词，后接 doing。

en: It's time for sb to do sth
zh: 到某人该做某事的时候了
example: It's time for us to leave.
question: It's time for us ___ leave.
note: It's time for + 名词；It's time to + 动词原形。

example: I didn't leave until the rain stopped.
question: I didn't leave ___ the rain stopped.
note: 主句否定，until 引出动作开始的时间界限。

example: Neither he nor I am ready.
question: Neither he ___ I am ready.
note: 连接主语时，谓语通常与最近的主语一致。

example: She is not only kind but also brave.
question: She is not only kind ___ also brave.
note: 两边语法形式应平行；连接主语时注意就近一致。

example: Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain.
question: Hardly had I arrived ___ it began to rain.
note: hardly 放句首，主句部分倒装；常用过去完成时。

example: No sooner had I arrived than it began to rain.
question: No sooner had I arrived ___ it began to rain.
note: no sooner 与 than 搭配；句首需要部分倒装。

example: She likes music. So do I.
question: She likes music. So ___ I.
note: so + 助动词／be／情态动词 + 主语。动词根据前句选择。

example: He doesn't smoke. Neither do I.
question: He doesn't smoke. Neither ___ I.
note: neither/nor + 助动词 + 主语；不要再加 not。

example: The match was cancelled because of the rain.
question: The match was cancelled because ___ the rain.
note: because 后接句子；because of 后接名词／代词／doing。

example: Although it was raining, we went out.
translation: 虽然下雨，我们还是出门了。
question: ___ it was raining, we went out.
note: 标准考试句式中 although 与 but 不在同一层重复连接。

zh: 保护某人免受某事伤害
example: The coat protects you from the cold.
question: The coat protects you ___ the cold.
note: protect...from/against...；本题 from 和 against 均可。

zh: 因某人做某事而感谢对方
example: Thank you for helping me.
question: Thank you ___ helping me.
note: for 后接感谢的原因，动词需用 doing。

example: I apologized to her for being late.
question: I apologized to her ___ being late.
note: to 后接人；for 后接原因。

example: She is good at solving problems.
question: She is good ___ solving problems.
note: at 是介词，后接 doing。

example: We succeeded in solving the problem.
question: We succeeded ___ solving the problem.
note: succeed 动词；success 名词；successful 形容词。

example: The rain prevented us from going out.
question: The rain prevented us from ___ out. (go)
note: from 后接 doing；keep sb from doing 中 from 不可省。

example: She is afraid to speak in public.
question: She is afraid ___ speak in public.
note: be afraid of doing 常强调害怕某种情况发生。

example: You are supposed to arrive on time.
question: You are supposed ___ arrive on time.
note: 常表示按规则、约定或期待应该做。

example: I would rather stay at home.
question: I would rather ___ at home. (stay)
note: would rather 后直接接动词原形。

example: You had better not stay up late.
question: You had better not ___ up late. (stay)
note: 否定式是 had better not do，不是 don't had better。

example: He promised to help me.
question: He promised ___ help me.
note: promise to do；不要套用 promise sb to do。

example: I decided to start today.
question: I decided ___ start today.
note: decide to do；decide on sth。

example: She refused to give up.
question: She refused ___ give up.
note: refuse 后接 to do。

example: We managed to finish on time.
question: We managed ___ finish on time.
note: manage to do 通常表示确实做成；try to do 不保证成功。

example: He failed to catch the bus.
question: He failed ___ catch the bus.
note: fail to do 表示没有成功做成。

example: I can't wait to see you.
question: I can't wait ___ see you.
note: 区别 can't help doing：忍不住做。
